name: visimark-vscode
description: Spreadsheet mechanics for Markdown: every computed number carries the formula that produced it.

scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out visimark.vsix
scripts.install-local: command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "VS Code CLI not found on PATH. In VS Code run: Shell Command: Install code command in PATH" >&2; exit 1; } && bun run package && code --install-extension visimark.vsix --force
scripts.uninstall-local: command -v code >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "VS Code CLI not found on PATH. In VS Code run: Shell Command: Install code command in PATH" >&2; exit 1; } && code --uninstall-extension michal-niedzwiedzki.visimark-vscode

visimark.check.debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after a keystroke before re-checking.

visimark.format.fixOnSave.markdownDescription: Rewrite every stale value when a Markdown file is saved. On by default: saving a document brings its computed cells and anchored values up to date, the same edits **VisiMark: Fix All Stale Values** makes. Only values VisiMark owns are touched — never prose, headings or input columns. Autosave (`files.autoSave`) never triggers it.

visimark.format.fixDates.markdownDescription: When formatting, also rewrite *decidable* non-ISO dates (`15.10.2026` becomes `2026-10-15`). Ambiguous dates are never touched.

visimark.inlayHints.enable.description: Show the computed value beside a stale value, without changing the file.

visimark.codeLens.enable.description: Show a lens above each vmark block.

visimark.statusBar.enable.description: Show VisiMark's status for the active document in the status bar.

visimark.server.path.description: Development only: path to a server entry point to run instead of the bundled one.

visimark.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the VisiMark language server.
